revenueModel.text: Enterprises pay subscription fees based on their licensed product consumption.
revenueModel.evidence: Through a suite of tools in the Dynatrace Account Management portal, we provide customers with a near real-time view of licensed product consumption, with historical analysis at the daily or hourly level.
